cars.generation: Original Mistral production-road six-cylinder GT family
cars.specification_market: Read the Mistral column on physical PDF page 134 and the separate 3700 development passage on page 43. Use 3694.4 cc and the 3700’s own bore/stroke; no Sebring column, 4000 output, body-spanning acceleration or unqualified weight is transferred. Maserati’s separate Classiche announcement establishes a road 3700 built in March 1969, supporting the reference year without claiming the photographed car is that certified example. No Spyder or extra engine-capacity record is counted.
cars.summary: The Mistral closed the classic Maserati straight-six GT lineage with Lucas injection, twin ignition and Pietro Frua’s distinctive fastback design. It adds an influential long-distance sporting coupe family, separate from the existing 3500 GT and later V8 Ghibli.
